A '''chainmail boots''' is the [[Chainmail armor|chainmail]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from {{MCW|Chain|iron chains}}. It gives 2 armor and has 300 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/chainmail_boots.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===

Worn, it gives 2 armor. The vanilla item gives 1 armor with 195 durability.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Thorns]] III

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Chainmail armor]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[Iron Ingot|iron ingots]]. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Iron Ingot|iron ingot]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/iron_ingot_from_blasting_iron_materials.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Armor durability and protection were made consistent across tiers (leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, hepatizon, steel < diamond, electrum < adamant). Chainmail armor became craftable.}}
}}
